question: Why did the error rate go up on 25 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment caused the error rate to increase.
why_chain: Checkout v8.9 was deployed to ap-south 211 minutes before the error rate increase.
The error rate for service checkout in region ap-south increased from 0.37% to 0.82%.
The deployment of checkout v8.9 is the most likely cause of the error rate increase.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment may have introduced a bug.
why_chain: Checkout v8.9 was deployed 211 minutes before the error rate increase.
The error rate increased, but the request volume and latency remained stable.
The deployment could have introduced a bug that was not caught in testing.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency remained stable.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: No configuration change was noted in the evidence.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout in region ap-south rose from 0.37% to 0.82% (+124%), with a change point at 2026-03-25T02:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.11).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout in region ap-south stayed about the same (175 per 5 min before, 187 per 5 min after, +7%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout in region ap-south stayed about the same (221 ms before, 221 ms after, -0%).
Deployed checkout v8.9 to ap-south (checkout, ap-south; 211 min before the change; record R010)

reasons: ✗ The closest change event is 211 min before the change, too far to be convincing.
✗ No logs or alerts from the affected segment confirm the problem.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
missing_data: Change records from the hour before the change
Error logs or traces from the affected segment after the change

actions.action: Rollback the deployment of checkout v8.9 to ap-south.
Implement a thorough pre-deployment testing process for the checkout v8.9 release.
Monitor error rates and request volumes closely after deployments to identify any anomalies.
